label.zh: 边境星系出现异常「失踪的行星」
label.en: The anomaly “The Missing Planets” appears in the border system

bridges.evidence: 5000.FASCINATING adds anomaly SOLARPUNK_CAT to the border system (events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:6691-6698); fircon.5000 is the only source of this anomaly (r2-mixed review, common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:703-715)

label.zh: 异常揭示后，进入哈宾特母星系
label.en: After the anomaly reveals them, enter the Habinte home system

bridges.evidence: fircon.5010 (anomaly success) sets solarpunk_discovered and star flag solarpunk_system_revealed and creates the Habinte country (events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:6761-6875); 5015 triggers on solarpunk_system_02 without solarpunk_mad (6889-6916); on_entering_system_fleet (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1050-1052)
on_survey_planet -> fircon.5020 (00_on_actions.txt:1163), trigger first_contact_dlc_events.txt:7000-7016 (survey of a planet owned by the solarpunk_country, once per empire)

label.en: Build an observation station (hidden 5025, 60 days later)

bridges.evidence: on_building_observation_station -> fircon.5025 (00_on_actions.txt:1956), also via fircon.30 (first_contact_dlc_events.txt:504); 5025 sets observed_solarpunk and fires 5026 after 60 days (7025-7056)

label.zh: 若入侵或轰炸他们（隐藏5034/5035）
label.en: If they are invaded or bombarded (hidden 5034/5035)

bridges.evidence: on_ground_combat_started -> fircon.5034 (00_on_actions.txt:801), on_planet_bombarded -> 5034 (2174), planet-killer queues -> 5035 (common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:29-206); 5034 sets up 5035 and the upgrade event 5045 (first_contact_dlc_events.txt:7123-7140); 5035 fires 5036 (7142-7214)

label.zh: 再次进入已愤怒的哈宾特星系
label.en: Enter the angered Habinte system again

bridges.evidence: on_entering_system_fleet -> fircon.5040 (00_on_actions.txt:1053), trigger first_contact_dlc_events.txt:7271-7305 (solarpunk_system_02 with solarpunk_mad, first time)

label.zh: 观测已久且发现已久：礼貌的请求（五年脉冲）
label.en: Long observed and not newly discovered: the polite request (five-year pulse)

bridges.evidence: on_five_year_pulse_country -> fircon.5050 (00_on_actions.txt:474), trigger first_contact_dlc_events.txt:7433-7446 (observed_solarpunk, not recently_discovered_solarpunk, not polite_request_fired)

label.zh: 拒绝请求：触发入侵后果

bridges.evidence: 5050.c fires colony_event 5035 on the capital and the upgrade event 5045 (first_contact_dlc_events.txt:7502-7512)

label.zh: 边境系统：尚未揭示用5000，已揭示用5005

note.zh: 5000 给系统添加“失踪的星球”异常；5005 仅提示。
note.en: 5000 adds the "Missing Planets" anomaly to the system; 5005 is informational.

label.zh: 愤怒与礼貌两条结局线

note.zh: 入侵/轰炸使哈宾特升级为真正的帝国并敌视你；星系封锁（solarpunk_mad）。
note.en: Invasion/bombardment turns Habinte into a real empire hostile to you; the system closes (solarpunk_mad).

scope.zh: 哈宾特统一星球国（太阳朋克社会）：接近、发现、观测、愤怒与礼貌的请求。
scope.en: Habinte Unified Worlds (Solarpunk Society): approach, discovery, observation, anger and the polite request.

uncertain: 2026-10-13 coordinator: the anomaly SOLARPUNK_CAT and its single outcome fircon.5010 (weight 1, r2-mixed review) are now family members, so the tree runs 5000 -> anomaly -> 5010 -> 5015; the former story anomaly-solarpunk-cat is absorbed.
The "planet X" swap that follows 5050.a lives in hidden event 5051 and was not traced line by line.
